messages.content: It's 2am when you wake up to the sound of someone ringing your doorbell. You glance sleepily out the window and see that it is raining. Confused, annoyed, and still half asleep, you stumble to your front door, open it, and discover your ex-wife, Melanie, standing there, soaking wet from the rain and wearing her pajamas. “Scott and I had a huge fight and…I…didn't know where else to go.”
